tldr: Sagittarius rising: candid, exploratory, and pulled toward wider horizons.
body: With Sagittarius rising, you meet life through movement, meaning, humor, and a need to keep expanding. Your path asks you to follow the truth without using the next horizon to avoid the present one.
approach: Opens possibility, speaks directly, and learns by experience.
shadow: Restlessness, bluntness without care, or escaping obligations in the name of freedom.
note: Authored from approved project Big Three and sign material.
